HOW TO READ THIS CANVAS

The top board is the architecture and the nine decisions. The five boards below are the layers, left to right in the order they read from each other. Two more boards, bottom right, answer the notes left on 2026-09-14: Menu and Icons.

Every sample is the real package CSS — what you see is what ships today. Each item carries a verdict:
Keep · Fix · Merge · Retire · Missing.

The two tweaks above every board (theme, block) switch the tokens. Nothing is restyled by them; that cascade is the whole argument.

D6 — THE ADMIN LAYOUT

The railed-page sample is the admin as built, reconstructed from source at real size. Under it is the Tool template I recommend (option B) and the two alternatives with their cost.

Pick A, B or C; the pick becomes a rule in Atomic.md.

NOT RENDERED HERE

The blob's refraction pattern and the six illustrations need the runtime (measured grid, the generator). Both are shown as stand-ins and marked so. The canvas nodes are reviewed from source.
Let's remove "Menu" from the Canvas layout. "Menu" should also be a component.

Menu Design Inspiration


We should have the following variants of the component.  


1. The layout displayed in the image.
2. A menu component that we can drag and drop in the Canvas. We should be able to add menu items.


Make sure to have responsive variants of the component.
We are still missing icons. We should add icons to the project.

ANSWERED — 2026-09-14

Your three notes became two boards below and two decisions on the top board:

D8 · Icons — an Icon atom, five weights drawn on the same glyphs, five sources. My pick: regular 1.5, Phosphor.

D9 · Menu — one Menu organism drawn from your reference in our tokens: column, icon rail, two columns, floating on the canvas, bottom sheet. It replaces the Rail and the canvas's built-in menu and is placeable with editable items.

Atomic.md carries both.
The border radius is not consistently rounded with Menu layouts above.
FIXED — the floating form now wears the column’s radii: xl outside, pill items, like every Menu above.

RECORDED — 2026-09-14

D1–D9 as recommended. Each is now a rule in Atomic.md §4 with its reason and cost, and §6’s build order starts: step 1, tokens.
